label: The nine's immanent operation derived from intellect as a capacity exercised by a pure act
summary: Follow-up to attempt 38c1e7b1 (PR #1479). Question: can the bare premise 8f93d9cc (NineOperate: whatever has the nine has an immanent operation, Operates of definition 7acc985a) be derived from commitments that do not nearly restate 'lives'? Result (specs/dei-filius-operation-from-intellect.toml, TruthCore/Causality/DeiFiliusOperationFromIntellect.lean, zero axioms): yes, from three open analyst premises: (1) 9c2a5dfe, whatever has intellect has the capacity to understand (CapacityPotency CanBe x understanding; POTENCY_3, DEF-CAPACITY-TO-BE; the respect of understanding is the new primitive definition 39f50105); (2) 4728d5f4, whatever has that capacity is in act in understanding (IN_ACT_3, the nine's shared InAct) or in potency to understanding (POTENCY_2, DEF-INDEPENDENT-POTENCY, the nine's generic InPotency), restricted to the one respect; it is the POTENCY sense bridge from POTENCY_3 to POTENCY_2 and is listed in sense_bridges of both deriving arguments (1715e54d, 6e939a75); (3) 021aaa19, whatever has the capacity to understand and is in act in understanding has an immanent operation (q.18 a.3 ad 1, no claim on file). Proof: a being with the nine has intellect (eighth) and is pure act (sixth, altogether immutability), so the potency branch of (2) is excluded and the act branch with (3) gives Operates (nineOperateFromCapacity, result 524a763b; constructive disjunction elimination). The intellect-restricted middle version e9d4901f (every pure act with intellect operates) is derived from the same three (c55e2ce2) and registered in the strength order between STMT-PURE-ACT-OPERATES (45030701) and 8f93d9cc (relations backed by 86ee4407 and f7bc7a96; strictness by the controls statement 29d1f5f5, result 5785fe99, parts 6-7). Controls: one omission model per premise, each with a being that has the nine and does not operate; nonvacuity; part 5 (the being with the nine operates and is neither LIVING_1 nor LIVING_2) holds trivially because Lives and LivesAt are unconstrained, so it shows only that no premise mentions life; the near-definitional worry is answered by the content audit below. PREMISE COMPARISON (computed frontier-diff against origin/main c220157db): one verified support alternative added (8f93d9cc from the three); 8f93d9cc moves bare -> closed; three bare premises added; open premises reaching the root 446 -> 448. The strength-order backing result alone (f7bc7a96, from e9d4901f) does not close 8f93d9cc by frontier rule, hence the direct composition 524a763b. WHERE THE WEIGHT NOW RESTS: (1) is close to the meaning of HAS_INTELLECT_1. (3) is a classification on the formal reading of InAct (7acc985a already lists understanding as an immanent operation); but InAct is the nine's shared predicate, read formally or virtually (DEF-UNIVERSALLY-PERFECT), and the capacity condition does not exclude virtual act, so on the inclusive reading (3) also carries the explicit open bridge that capable virtual act of understanding is an immanent operation (Codex review P1 on PR #1481). (2) carries the act/potency content: under POTENCY_2 it is substantive, classically the right-to-left half of the Metaphysics IX.6 analysis (STMT-POTENCY-IS-UNACTUALIZED-CAPACITY) at one respect, with no argument from that statement registered since it would need excluded middle (zero-axiom policy). Unregistered alternative reading: under the adopted specialization POTENCY_1 (AdoptedPotency.InPotency: capable and not actually), (2) is only excluded middle for actually understanding at a capable being (exercisedOrInPotencyOfDecidable in the Solution, unregistered), and the weight moves into PureAct. RESTRICTION TO ONE RESPECT, by cases: ST I q.25 a.5 (attribution deferred) concerns active power, a capacity to produce an effect (q.25 a.1), while CanBe is an ability to be in a state. If producing an effect is not a CanBe respect, the general (every-respect) version of (2) does not face q.25 a.5 and that passage does not motivate the restriction. If it is, under POTENCY_1 PureAct (the sixth of the nine) already requires every such capacity exercised, so the point targets the nine's pure-act conjunct and restricting (2) does not escape it. Only under POTENCY_2 does the restricted version avoid it while the general one would face it. Definition 39f50105 now records that CanBe at understanding is the receptive capacity of the IX.6 knower, not an active power; no record yet carries the active/passive power distinction. OBJECTION AUDIT (substantive objection standard): timeless agency (understanding requires succession) targets neither the inference nor (1)-(3) as stated (none is time-indexed) but the joint satisfiability of intellect with pure act. Mechanism: (1), (2) and pure act make every intellectual pure act understand; if understanding entails potency in some respect (to a further thought), that contradicts pure act, so no pure act has intellect, the nine would be unsatisfiable and the route vacuous. No independent justification for the succession mechanism is on file (Pike, God and Timelessness; Swinburne, The Coherence of Theism; Lucas: unread leads, no weight). Divine intellect not a faculty distinct from its act (q.14 a.4): does not target (1), since CanBe requires no distinct faculty and holds of whatever actually understands. No substantive objection to the restricted premises identified. Independent semantic challenge (coordinator, 2026-11-12): accepted with the wording and link repairs recorded here. Attribution deferred throughout; no claim states any new premise; no premise is established.
blocker: Not blocked. Next tests: a perfection route (IsPerfect: some being actually understands, so a universally perfect being is in act in understanding) would lean entirely on the virtual-act bridge inside (3) on its inclusive reading and belongs with the perfection-transfer lane; a record carrying the active/passive power distinction, which would decide the q.25 a.5 case split; a time-indexed understanding respect under which the succession question could be posed and tested against the nine (the open obligation of 7acc985a); a typed LIVING_1 under which the sense bridge could be derived or fail.
